text: No. Do not bridge a blown fuse with wire, foil or any other conductive material. Replace the blown fuse with a new fuse of the same rating. The manual lists spare fuses at 5 A (SF1), 10 A (SF2) and 15 A (SF3). Watch out: Any attempt to jumper a defective fuse risks a short circuit and fire. Watch out: Fuses of other ratings, low-grade fuses or conductive materials will damage the complete electrical system. Watch out: After any fuse failure, get the electrical system checked and the faults corrected immediately, or fuses may keep failing. Watch out: Replace a spare fuse in the holder at the earliest opportunity. The manual gives no way to keep riding on a blown fuse.
